merged.title: feat(port): optimise probe baking and add edge-aware texture upscaling
merged.author: pezzadev
merged.untrustedBody:
## Changes

- Reuse loaded level assets and one prepared Embree scene across sparse and dense grids. Cache sampling directions, share primary first hits, and use alpha filters and occlusion queries for visibility.
- Integrate probe maps with portable four-lane C++, a specialised exponent-32 path and 2x2 subtexel sampling. Cache dense-region merge candidates without changing their ordering.
- Add optional Vulkan edge-aware 2x world-texture colours, preserving original alpha and mip sampling with a bounded 64 MiB cache. Expose the option in the launcher's Enhanced settings.
- Align the launcher's AO default with the game, clarify Reset to defaults, and split baking, transport, reporting and fixtures into focused files. Adapt texture-provider registration to the new scene-module layout.

## Verification

- Built the offline baker, game frontend and viewer on Windows/Vulkan.
- Six native bake suites pass: `probe_bake`, `probe_visibility`, `probe_lighting`, `probe_bake_parallel`,

merged.title: feat: Android launcher and controls round: touch camera, Mods tab, Enhanced graphics, themes
merged.author: mateuszklysz
merged.untrustedBody:
## Summary

A large round of work on the Android launcher and the game's controls, tested on the Ayn Odin 3. It also brings changes that every platform gets: launcher themes, an update window that opens by itself, a restyled in-game options drawer and better analog stick handling.

## Changelog

### Controls (port)

- **Analog sticks reach their corners, like a DualShock 2.** Ratchet only runs when the stick is pushed all the way. A round stick (PS4/Xbox pads, the on-screen stick) only reached about 0.71 on each axis at a diagonal, so Ratchet walked. A push near the rim is now stretched out to the square, so a full diagonal runs.
  - Only the outer part is stretched: the stretch eases in from 80% of the way to the rim and is complete at the rim. Partial pushes and resting-stick drift stay exactly as the gamepad reports them.
  - A gamepad whose stick already reports a square (such as the Odin 3's) is detected the first time it reports a position clearly past a circle, and is

merged.title: feat(port): add FSR upscaling and pipelined rendering
merged.author: pezzadev
merged.untrustedBody:
Adds FSR 3.1.4 temporal upscaling to enhanced Vulkan rendering, with Quality as the default and the HUD drawn at display resolution. Frame generation is excluded.

## Changes

- Preserve authored smooth normals through export, the depth/normal prepass, GI and GTAO; fix false AO at grazing angles.
- Keep dense probe regions local, retain up to 512 resident regions and select a stable 128-region lookup for tiled sampling.
- Add per-level sunlight direction overrides shared by direct lighting, shadows and baked bounces.
- Give Ratchet and attached equipment a dedicated shadow, with smooth transitions to downward projection in the air and a platforming cue inside cascade shadows.
- Batch temporal object-motion draws and bindless upscaled materials, cache the last graphics pipeline, and restore texture debanding.
- Enable the Vulkan render worker by default, with owned scene snapshots and a bounded handoff. Show whole-frame, CPU and GPU timing modes in the frame counter.
- Automat

merged.title: Drop the NTSC decomp submodule: NTSC-U built here, the NTSC decomp read at a pin
merged.author: Veradictus
merged.untrustedBody:
The `versions/ntsc` submodule put 2,122 files of the NTSC decomp into every recursive clone. It goes. Nothing about matching changes: no new C, no ports.

- **NTSC-U is a version like PAL v1.00 and NTSC-J** (`tools/versions.py` drops the `submodule` field). merged.title: Link verified compiler jump tables and integrate five C functions
merged.author: llesieur99
merged.untrustedBody:
Ordinary C switches previously passed the local instruction checker but fell back to retail assembly because their compiler-generated branch tables had no place in the linked image. Retain verified `.rodata`/`.rdata` sections at the addresses derived from their text relocations and interleave them with the remaining retail data, following RAC1's placement approach.

Every table word must have one R_MIPS_32 relocation to an independently placed C text section in the same object. Validate entry order and destinations, section bounds/alignment and overlapping claims. Keep dependencies scoped to their object. Reject mixed/scalar pools and missing destinations. Neither compiler instructions nor table values are rewritten; strict loaded-byte comparison remains the acceptance gate.

Integrate the retained ordinary-C color conversions `func_L04_004323F8` and `func_L04_00432530`, Grelbin controller `func_L19_00421E80`, format dispatcher `func_00118CC8` and DWARF interpreter `func_00123D30`.

merged.title: Match three switch functions and correct Joba case mappings
merged.author: llesieur99
merged.untrustedBody:
Integrate the shared message selector `func_L02_004114A0` and the two Joba index converters `func_L11_0043E090` / `func_L11_0043E108`, using the compiler-owned branch-table placement merged in #312. These add 408 distinct primary code bytes; no build mechanism or compiler profile changes are needed.

The retained Joba drafts had instruction-exact bodies but incorrect switch mappings. The table validator rejected both because their R_MIPS_32 case destinations disagreed with retail. Correct the ordinary C `case` labels while preserving the emitted text layout, then link and compare the complete tables. Keep the three bodies in separate C units so their tables preserve the measured retail spacing without artificial padding or aliases.
